'''Sehar''' is a village in [[Altara]], located a few miles from the [[River Eldar]] and [[Amadicia]].

When [[Morgase Trakand]], [[Lini Eltring]], [[Martyn Tallanvor]], [[Basel Gill]], [[Breane Taborwin]] and [[Lamgwin Dorn]] are traveling through Altara, they pass through Sehar on their way to [[Cormaed]].{{ref/book|5|56}}
